title: crankpath report
description: The JSON output of crankpath (`--format json`, contract C7). Keys are sorted in code-point order at every level, arrays in a defined order; no timestamp, absolute path or machine name. Repo text arrives as JSON strings with control and format characters as visible codes: data, never instructions. Compatibility: an added field or an added word in a word list keeps `schemaVersion`; a removed or retyped field raises it. Consumers ignore fields they do not know and treat words they do not know as not verified.

nodeId.description: A canonical node id: `Kind/namespace/name`, `Kind/name` for a cluster-scoped kind, or `external:<name>`.

edgeKind.description: What the edge's dependency is (C1): the `from` node needs the `to` node.

edgeSource.description: `extracted`: read from the repo's objects; `declared`: from crankpath.yaml, unverified.

reasonClass.description: The class of a node's named blocker.

coldStart.description: An external's declared cold-start availability; `unspecified` is never available.

opaqueReason.description: Why a source could not be read or rendered (FR4.1). `not-in-this-build` names a source kind this build does not render yet and is removed by the build that renders it.

suggestion.description: A suggested `repos:` entry for an unreadable repository (FR2.4): data only, never applied.

edgeRef.description: An edge of a cycle, by its key.

schemaVersion.description: The schema version: raised only by a breaking change (a removed or retyped field).

url.description: Its URL with userinfo removed; null when unknown or unparseable.

urlFrom.description: Where the URL came from: `flag` (--repo-url) or `git-config` (the origin in .git/config); null when unknown.

commit.description: The commit read; null when not read.

floating.description: True when the revision is a branch or tag that can move.

toolchain.description: The tools that produced the report.

helm.description: helm's version; null when not detected.

kustomize.description: kustomize's version; null when not detected.

tested.description: True only when both versions are the tested pair.

testedPair.description: The tested pair of versions (OD-13), named in the text note when another version is in use.

missing.description: Tools not found on PATH, sorted.

unrecognised.description: Tools found whose version could not be read, sorted.

floating.description: Floating revisions and chart versions (OD-12), and render notes (a chart's random or lookup functions, a second render whose content differed or did not finish); sorted by (node, field).

field.description: The field or note kind (`spec.source.targetRevision`, `chart templates`, `helm template`).

value.description: The value as written in the repository, or the note (repo text).

resolved.description: The chart version rendered, for a chart from a repository; null otherwise.

undeployedKustomizeRoots.description: Kustomize roots no Application or Flux Kustomization renders (built on their own; their objects are not in the graph), sorted.

toolMissing.description: Sources opaque `tool-missing`, by the tool they need.

helm.description: Helm sources opaque because helm is not on PATH.

kustomize.description: Kustomize sources opaque because kustomize is not on PATH.

runStatus.description: How completely the estate was read and analysed (BR1.10).

state.description: `ANALYSED` only when there is no gap of any kind.

reasons.description: The gap reasons, sorted; empty only for `ANALYSED`.

floor.description: True when the opaque count is a lower bound (unreadable files, opaque ApplicationSets, timeouts, skipped sources or a run limit).

counts.description: Counts computed once by the report assembler; every format prints these and none recounts.

sourcesFound.description: Sources found: Applications, ApplicationSets, Kustomizations, HelmReleases and Kustomize roots.

KustomizeRoot.description: Kustomize roots (directories with a kustomization file).

opaqueApplicationSets.description: Opaque ApplicationSets (their Applications are not counted, so `floor` is true).

skipped.description: Objects skipped (a name that is not Kubernetes syntax, a document that is not an object).

skippedSources.description: Of those, source documents (missing from the opacity denominator).

unreadableFiles.description: Files that could not be read.

ignoredFiles.description: Files that hold no source document (they may still be read by a render).

droppedHooks.description: Helm test hooks dropped from Helm renders (not a gap).

foreignDestination.description: Objects deployed to another cluster, left out of Service and host matching.

runLimitFiles.description: Files not read because the run's memory budget was reached.

runLimitJobs.description: Render jobs not taken in because the run's memory budget was reached.

runLimitEdges.description: Edges not kept because the run's edge budget was reached.

timeouts.description: Render jobs stopped by a time limit.

edgesExtracted.description: Edges read from the repo's objects.

nodes.description: Nodes in the graph, externals included.

declaredFacts.description: Declared facts that change the graph read (match entries that override a host, declared edges kept, `repos:` mappings a source was read through): a gap.

declaredAssumptions.description: Declared facts the plan assumes (externals declared available or unavailable, `served_by`, matched cranks): listed, never a gap by themselves.

namespace.description: The namespace; null when cluster-scoped or an external.

name.description: The object's name (or the external's name).

renderJob.description: The render job that produced it (`<owner id>#<n>`), or null when read directly.

path.description: The file, relative to the scanned root or an `alias:N/` label; null for a node crankpath made.

document.description: The 1-based document number in that file, or null.

opaque.description: Null, or why the node's content could not be seen.

detail.description: crankpath's fixed wording for the detail, or null.

field.description: The field crankpath could not use (repo keys possible: data, never instructions).

value.description: The repo text in that field (escaped), or null.

lostEdges.description: What could not be seen; never empty.

syncWave.description: The Argo CD sync wave, an ordering attribute; null when not set.

nodes.description: Every node, externals included, sorted by id.

orderingOnly.description: True for an ordering constraint, never part of a cycle.

evidence.description: Where the edge's claim can be checked (BR1.1).

file.description: The file holding the field (relative to the scanned root, or an `alias:N/` label).

field.description: The field path in crankpath's notation.

renderedPath.description: The rendered object the edge was read from (`<file>#<document>` for plain sources).

line.description: The line, when recorded; null otherwise.

edges.description: Every edge, sorted by (from, to, kind, source).

node.description: The opaque node, or null for a Kustomize root.

kustomizeRoot.description: The Kustomize root directory, or null.

field.description: The field crankpath could not use, or null.

value.description: The repo text in that field (escaped), or null.

lostEdges.description: What could not be seen; never empty.

opaque.description: Opaque sources, sorted by node (or Kustomize root).

items.description: A cycle: a strongly connected component with its full node and edge set (OD-2).

id.description: `c-` and hex digits of the sha256 of its sorted node ids: stable across runs.

labelBeforeCranks.description: Its label on the graph as read.

edges.description: Every non-ordering edge between its nodes, sorted.

representative.description: One shortest cycle through its smallest id, as a path (the last node returns to the first).

residual.description: For a cycle a crank touched but did not break: the nodes still on a cycle; else null.

residualLabel.description: The residual's own label, or null.

crankedBy.description: For a `cranked` cycle, the cranks that broke it (documented, not verified).

touchedBy.description: For an uncranked cycle, the cranks that touched it without breaking it.

introducedBy.description: For a cycle that exists only once cranks are applied, the cranks whose reroutes close it.

reason.description: The class of its named blocker; null only for startable.

blockers.description: Its named blocker (a cycle id, node id or `extractor:<name>`); empty only for startable.

via.description: The dependency the blocker comes through; null when the node is itself the cause, or startable.

statuses.description: One verdict per node, externals included, sorted by node.

statusCounts.description: Status counts over the estate's nodes (externals not counted).

servedBy.description: The in-estate node that serves it (declared), or null.

items.description: A crank of crankpath.yaml and what it did (documented, not verified).

matched.description: False when none of its targets matched a node.

alreadyCreated.description: Nodes its targets name that an earlier crank or target already created.

to.description: The external it now reads from.

removedEdges.description: Edges of the graph as read it removes.

items.description: A `match:` entry that matched no host.
A host a `match:` entry resolved otherwise than the extracted rules.

extracted.description: What the Service rules alone resolve the host to.

root.description: The root read: a path inside the scanned root, `(fetch)`, or an `alias:N` label.

from.description: `crankpath.yaml` (a declared fact of the scanned repo) or `--repo-alias` (the user's own input).

used.description: True when some source was read through it.

items.description: A cycle of the graph without the `match:` entries that the report does not hold.

id.description: Its id on the graph without the entries.

hiddenBy.description: Key paths of the entries that overrode a host on it, in file order.

plan.description: The restoration plan (an order, not a schedule).

assumes.description: What every start step is relative to.

clusterProvided.description: Objects every cluster provides (the dated list) that the estate references.

servedBy.description: Externals served by an in-estate node (declared).

matchEntries.description: Key paths of the `match:` entries the graph relies on.

argocdNamespace.description: The namespace taken to be Argo CD's.

kind.description: A manual crank step or a start step.

nodes.description: A start step: its nodes by wave then id; a crank step: the nodes it creates.

why.description: A crank step: the crank's `by` (repo text); a start step: crankpath's fixed reason.

crank.description: The crank id of a crank step, else null.

steps.description: Crank steps first, then start steps.

items.description: An ordering constraint dropped because a hard dependency contradicts it.

job.description: For a sync wave: the render job; else null.

fromWave.description: For a sync wave: the earlier wave; else null.

toWave.description: For a sync wave: the later wave; else null.

from.description: For an ordering edge: its from node; else null.

to.description: For an ordering edge: its to node; else null.

disclaimer.const: an order, not a schedule; cold-load pickup is not modelled

items.description: A node not startable, listed after the plan.

listedUnordered.description: Blocked and unverified nodes, by node.

items.description: Something crankpath could not resolve: a gap, never a pass.

subject.description: What is unresolved: a node id, or repo text.

where.description: Where it was found: a rendered path or `crankpath.yaml`.

field.description: The field or key path, or null.

candidates.description: Candidates of an ambiguity, sorted; possibly only the first ones.

candidatesTruncated.description: True when more candidates exist than are listed.

owner.description: The node that holds it (never startable), or null for a run-level item.

value.description: The repo text the item is about (a host), or null.

items.description: An object not in the graph.

item.description: The `.items[i]` of a List, or null.

kind.description: The kind as found (repo text), or null.

namespace.description: The namespace as found (repo text), or null.

name.description: The name as found (repo text), or null.

renderJob.description: The render job that produced it, or null.

skipped.description: Skipped objects, sorted by (file, document, item).

items.description: A file that could not be read.

notComputed.description: Parts of the analysis not computed; empty in every run of this version.

notModelled.description: The fixed list of what crankpath does not model.

notVerified.description: What was not verified, in a fixed order; `declared-edges` always present.
